_note: The overland world between the playable areas (docs/WORLD_TRAVEL.md). Every route is a canonical connection of data/world.json; km and terrain set how many days it takes. Waypoints are real places along it (km from the 'from' end): settlements are safe, shelters half-safe, the wild is danger by habitat. The JourneyDirector walks a party along these legs day by day; Wayside pockets are generated where the party stops.
